newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian boy dies after bus attack.
newsitem.headline: Albanian boy dies after bus attack.

text.p: A six-year-old Albanian boy died on Thursday from his wounds after gunmen sprayed a crowded public bus with automatic rifle fire near the capital, hospital sources said. He was the second person to die from the attack.
Gunmen sprayed the bus with bullets on Wednesday evening, killing one passenger immediately and wounding seven others, including the boy, just south of the capital.
It was one of the worst incidents of violence near Tirana since rioting swept the country in January and rebels seized the south in a March insurrection.
The gunmen overtook the bus in a four-wheel drive vehicle near the village of Sauk, just south of the capital, and then opened fire. The motive for the attack was unknown.
Albania has been swept by violence since January when a series of fraudulent investment schemes collapsed. Most of the south has been taken over by rebels in an armed insurrection.
The lawlessness which has reigned in the south has been rare in Tirana, where police and the army are still in control.
